speaker: Unknown
en: Hey, let's get started.
zh: 大家好，让我们开始吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Good morning, everyone.
zh: 大家早上好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm Uday.
zh: 我是 Uday。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm here with my colleague, Adam.
zh: 我和我的同事 Adam 一起来到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll talk about our journey towards Managed Software Factory.
zh: 我们将谈谈我们迈向 Managed Software Factory 的历程。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in the beginning, in the first part of the talk, I'll talk about the key building blocks that we are investing in.
zh: 在演讲的第一部分，我会谈谈我们正在投入的关键构建模块。

speaker: Unknown
en: And later, Adam's going to talk about how we take all of these blocks to build an end-to-end cohesive solution for our engineers.
zh: 稍后，Adam 会讲我们如何利用所有这些模块为我们的工程师构建一个端到端的整体解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: To set some context, we have a few thousand engineers across 12 global tech sites.
zh: 先交代一些背景，我们在全球 12 个技术园区拥有几千名工程师。

speaker: Unknown
en: Over the last year, all of the investments we made in agentic AI have led to more than 70% of our PRs, now either by local or cloud agents.
zh: 过去一年，我们在 agentic AI 上的所有投入使得我们超过 70% 的 PR 现在由本地或云端智能体完成。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all of this led to twice the number of lines of code per engineer year over year.
zh: 而这一切使得每位工程师的代码行数同比增长了一倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this extends way beyond coding, and we see it in every aspect of the engineering lifecycle today.
zh: 而且这远不止于编码，今天我们在工程生命周期的方方面面都能看到它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we are also accelerating toil reduction at a massive pace.
zh: 我们还在以极快的速度加速减少苦活（toil）。

speaker: Unknown
en: We handled more than 250 automated migrations, relatively 9 million lines of code automatically for our engineers.
zh: 我们为工程师处理了超过 250 次自动化迁移，相对地自动化迁移了约 900 万行代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: And before even the building blocks, all the investments we made over the last six years on moving to MonoRepos, moving to Bazel, all of that also laid a really solid foundation for us to accelerate this.
zh: 甚至在这些构建模块之前，我们过去六年里在迁移到 MonoRepos、迁移到 Bazel 上的所有投入，也为我们加速这一切奠定了非常坚实的基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the first, I'll cover all of these six building blocks, and Adam's going to talk about a specific example and show how that feature can be built end to end with all of these.
zh: 首先，我会讲这六个构建模块，Adam 会用一个具体例子展示如何用所有这些端到端地构建一个功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all of these are in various stages of maturity and rollout within Uber, but we want to give everyone a sneak peek of what we are up to.
zh: 所有这些都处于 Uber 内部不同成熟度和推广阶段，但我们想让大家先睹为快。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's go to the building blocks, the six building blocks one by one.
zh: 那么让我们逐个看这些构建模块，这六个构建模块。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first one is model gateway.
zh: 第一个是 model gateway。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is one of our earlier investments.
zh: 这是我们较早的投入之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: The three things that we wanted to ensure was no PII ever leaves our perimeter to any of the vendor by default.
zh: 我们想确保的三件事是：默认情况下，任何 PII 都不会离开我们的边界流向任何供应商。

speaker: Unknown
en: And any guardrail that we add here, the latency of that is strictly bounded.
zh: 而且我们在这里添加的任何护栏，其延迟都有严格的上限。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every request that goes through this, we need to be able to attribute per user, per project, and per team.
zh: 每一个经过这里的请求，我们都要能够按用户、按项目、按团队进行归因。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have a model gateway and we made sure all of our internal use cases, our coding harnesses, our external use cases, they all go through one single OpenAI Anthropic compatible endpoint.
zh: 所以我们有一个 model gateway，并确保所有内部用例、我们的编码工具链、外部用例，都经过一个单一的 OpenAI Anthropic 兼容端点。

speaker: Unknown
en: It goes through a series of middlewares.
zh: 它经过一系列中间件。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first one is identity and authentication using Spire.
zh: 第一个是使用 Spire 的身份认证。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a data anonymizer that redacts 20 plus PI types.
zh: 我们有一个数据匿名化器，可脱敏 20 多种 PII 类型。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have an AI guard that has five specialized models that handles various parts of safety and policy that we want to ensure, and all of that runs under 100 milliseconds.
zh: 我们有一个 AI guard，它有五个专门模型，处理我们想要确保的安全和策略的各个方面，这一切都在 100 毫秒内运行完成。

speaker: Unknown
en: We also are investing in all kinds of caching and token optimization strategies at this layer.
zh: 我们还在这层投入各种缓存和 token 优化策略。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every request that goes through this, we are able to attribute a specific project in our catalog.
zh: 每一个经过这里的请求，我们都能归因到我们目录中的具体项目。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we can attribute per caller, per user, per team, both in real time, but also in our data lake.
zh: 我们可以按调用方、按用户、按团队归因，既实时进行，也记录到我们的数据湖中。

speaker: Unknown
en: This enables us to create all kinds of spent years and guardrails in a holistic way across our portfolio.
zh: 这使我们能够跨整个产品组合以整体的方式创建各种支出护栏和护栏机制。

speaker: Unknown
en: We also use this layer for capturing audit log session traces, which are then plugged into our benchmarking and all kinds of self-improvement loop efforts.
zh: 我们还用这一层来捕获审计日志和会话轨迹，然后接入我们的基准测试和各种自我改进循环的工作中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for an engineer at Uber, you take the vanilla client, you set the project ID, and we take care of everything else.
zh: 对于 Uber 的工程师来说，你只需使用原生客户端，设置 project ID，其余的一切都由我们来处理。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today we have 800 plus projects internally going through this, cumulatively handling more than 100 million model requests per day.
zh: 今天，我们内部有 800 多个项目经过这里，累计每天处理超过 1 亿次模型请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: This includes both the frontier models and also open source models, whether that is hosted in our infrastructure or some of our vendors.
zh: 这包括前沿模型和开源模型，无论是托管在我们自己的基础设施上，还是某些供应商那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next is how do we provide tools to all of these models?
zh: 下一个是我们如何为所有这些模型提供工具？

speaker: Unknown
en: Last year, when we started on this journey, we had thousands of internal APIs, but none of them are agent taxable out of the box.
zh: 去年当我们开始这段旅程时，我们有数千个内部 API，但没有一个开箱即用就是可被智能体调用的（agent taxable）。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we had so many other SaaS tools, and each one of them have different way to authenticate, different way to set up, which is a lot of hassle for everyone.
zh: 我们还有很多其他 SaaS 工具，每一个都有不同的认证方式、不同的设置方式，这对每个人来说都很麻烦。

speaker: Unknown
en: And once you end up with enough MCPs, they'll all add up and have a massive token tax.
zh: 而且一旦你装了足够多的 MCP，它们会累加起来，产生巨大的 token 税。

speaker: Unknown
en: Similar to Model Gateway, we have an MCP Gateway that handles a whole bunch of middlewares for engineers.
zh: 与 Model Gateway 类似，我们有一个 MCP Gateway，为工程师处理一大堆中间件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have an automated crawler that looks at our internal APIs and projects all of these into MCPs with one single config change.
zh: 我们有一个自动化爬虫，它会查看我们的内部 API，只需一个配置变更就把这些全部投影成 MCP。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we do the same thing even for our SaaS MCPs.
zh: 我们对我们的 SaaS MCP 也做同样的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Whether it's Google, Slack, Jira, all of this, they go to the MCP gateway.
zh: 无论是 Google、Slack、Jira，所有这些都接入 MCP gateway。

speaker: Unknown
en: We host them.
zh: 我们托管它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: We do the token exchange.
zh: 我们做 token 交换。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for all the engineers, they go through one single entry point, one common way to install any MCPs.
zh: 所以对所有工程师来说，它们都经过一个单一入口，用一种统一的方式安装任何 MCP。

speaker: Unknown
en: This simplified a lot for all of our engineers and employees.
zh: 这为我们所有工程师和员工大大简化了流程。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the whole bunch of token optimization strategies.
zh: 然后是一整套 token 优化策略。

speaker: Unknown
en: We initially had direct MCP pattern.
zh: 我们最初是直连 MCP 模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Earlier this year, we created OmniMCP, which is one single MCP that you install which can discover and invoke any MCPs within the gateway.
zh: 今年早些时候，我们创建了 OmniMCP，这是一个你只需安装一个的 MCP，它可以发现并调用网关内的任何 MCP。

speaker: Unknown
en: And a couple of months ago, we projected all of these MCPs into CLI pattern so that even the response doesn't eat up in your context.
zh: 几个月前，我们把所有这些 MCP 投影到 CLI 模式，这样连响应也不会吃掉你的上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of late, we also have a code mode skill, which is auto-installed, which on the fly creates Python scripts to hyper-optimize some of the top MCP token consuming use cases.
zh: 最近，我们还有一个自动安装的 code mode 技能，它会即时创建 Python 脚本来超优化一些 token 消耗最高的 MCP 用例。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all of this led to, like, now we have 1,000-plus MCP tools, and just with these optimization efforts, we've saved more than 40% fleet-wide savings.
zh: 所有这些带来的结果是，现在我们拥有 1000 多个 MCP 工具，仅凭这些优化工作，我们就在整个集群范围内节省了超过 40%。

speaker: Unknown
en: So once we have the models and the tools, we need a place to run all of this.
zh: 所以一旦我们有了模型和工具，我们就需要一个地方来运行这一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: For many years, we had DevPort, which is our cloud remote environments.
zh: 很多年来，我们有 DevPort,这是我们的云端远程环境。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had this because we had large monoreports with millions of lines of code.
zh: 我们之所以有这个，是因为我们有数百万行代码的大型 monoreport。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is how engineers work at Uber.
zh: 这就是 Uber 工程师的工作方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now we took what we had with DevPorts and we identified that.
zh: 现在我们拿出了已有的 DevPort,我们识别出这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some environment for agents to run for a longer period of time.
zh: 需要某种环境让智能体运行更长的时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: They need to be quick.
zh: 它们需要快速。

speaker: Unknown
en: They need to be isolated.
zh: 它们需要被隔离。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can install any number of them.
zh: 我们可以安装任意数量的它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they need to be globally available across all of our sites.
zh: 而且它们需要在我们所有站点全球可用。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have a pre-provisioned Kubernetes balloon pods.
zh: 所以我们有预置的 Kubernetes balloon pods。

speaker: Unknown
en: When an agent requires a new environment to run, it can take one of that, which is already pre-provisioned.
zh: 当一个智能体需要新的环境来运行时，它可以取用一个已经预置好的环境。

speaker: Unknown
en: It has all of the repositories already snapshotted.
zh: 它已经把所有仓库都做了快照。

speaker: Unknown
en: The search index is already built.
zh: 搜索索引已经建好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the agents can start working within a matter of seconds.
zh: 所以智能体可以在几秒钟内开始工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next thing we noticed is the roles of engineers are getting blurred.
zh: 我们注意到的下一件事是工程师的角色正在变得模糊。

speaker: Unknown
en: We used to offer a dev port per language flavor for Go, Java, Android, and so on.
zh: 我们过去为每种语言版本提供一个 dev port,包括 Go、Java、Android 等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now we need agents to work across repositories and engineers also to work across repositories.
zh: 现在我们需要智能体跨仓库工作，工程师也要跨仓库工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have a mega dev port that has all of the repositories in one common place.
zh: 所以我们有一个 mega dev port,把所有仓库放在一个共同的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is what we use for our autonomous coding agents now.
zh: 这就是我们现在用于自主编码智能体的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even for our non-engineered employees, we are providing a simple way for them to get started with any of the agent harnesses in a matter of seconds.
zh: 甚至对于我们的非工程员工，我们也提供了一种简单的方式，让他们在几秒钟内开始使用任何智能体 harness。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then now we get to knowledge part of it.
zh: 然后现在我们到了知识的部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we jumped on this bandwagon earlier this year.
zh: 我们在今年早些时候搭上了这趟车。

speaker: Unknown
en: We started noticing engineers building tons of skills across many repositories.
zh: 我们开始注意到工程师在许多仓库里构建了大量技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: When three problems we noticed was there's a lot of duplication, same skill being built by different engineers in different repos, and discovery and configuration was a huge hassle, and a lot of skills were of subpar quality.
zh: 我们注意到的三个问题是存在大量重复，不同的工程师在不同的仓库里构建相同的技能，发现和配置是一大麻烦事，而且很多技能质量不佳。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we built an entire lifecycle around skills.
zh: 所以我们围绕技能构建了完整的生命周期。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have core skills and domain-specific skills.
zh: 我们有核心技能和领域专属技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of that go into a managed skills marketplace.
zh: 所有这些都进入一个托管式技能市场。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have 2,500 skills there right now.
zh: 我们现在那里有 2500 个技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it goes through a whole bunch of link checks, automated reviews, which ensures a baseline skill quality for any skills that we have.
zh: 它会经过一整套链接检查、自动化评审，这为我们拥有的任何技能确保了基线的技能质量。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we also simplified the installation and discovery.
zh: 我们还简化了安装和发现。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there is one single command to discover and install any plugin in our ecosystem.
zh: 所以只需一条命令就可以在我们的生态系统中发现并安装任何插件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And based on the engineer personas, we even auto-installed some of the default skills so the agents automatically can pick up the right skill.
zh: 而且基于工程师画像，我们甚至自动安装了一些默认技能，这样智能体就能自动挑选正确的技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't even have to install them.
zh: 你甚至不需要安装它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And off late, we started working on collecting traces and comments and capturing continuous evals so that we can give feedback back to the skill others for skill improvements.
zh: 而最近，我们开始着手收集 traces 和评论、捕获持续评估，这样我们可以把反馈回馈给技能作者以改进技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is an area of big investment for us right now.
zh: 这是我们现在大力投入的一个领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have 2,500 skills and relatively more than 20,000 skill executions per day across our fleet.
zh: 我们有 2500 个技能，整个集群每天有超过 20000 次技能执行。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next piece of knowledge is context graphs.
zh: 知识的下一块是上下文图。

speaker: Unknown
en: We started noticing in our execution traces agents spending a lot of time even trying to find basic context, especially in our large monorepos.
zh: 我们开始在执行 traces 中注意到智能体花大量时间甚至只是试图找到基本的上下文，尤其是在我们的大型 monorepo 中。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to identify where the service is located, what are the dependencies, who wants it, what kind of patterns I need to follow.
zh: 你需要识别服务位于哪里，有哪些依赖，谁在用它，我需要遵循什么样的模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all of this context is gathered across scattered systems across Uber.
zh: 而所有这些上下文分散在 Uber 各处的系统中收集。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's 20 to 30 different systems.
zh: 有 20 到 30 个不同的系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: Each needs its own skills, its own MCPs to gather the context.
zh: 每个系统都需要自己的技能、自己的 MCP 来收集上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this burns tokens.
zh: 而这会烧掉 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: This adds a lot of latency.
zh: 这增加了很多延迟。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it creates more unpredictable outcomes.
zh: 并且它造成更多不可预测的结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have one context graph.
zh: 所以我们有一个上下文图。

speaker: Unknown
en: We took all of the information of how Uber runs into one context graph.
zh: 我们把 Uber 运行的所有信息都整合进了一个上下文图谱。

speaker: Unknown
en: This has 150 unique node and edge types.
zh: 它有 150 种独特的节点和边类型。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have 40 million entries there right now.
zh: 我们目前里面有 4000 万条条目。

speaker: Unknown
en: It captures all the way from how our mobile apps are built to our backend to our data lake, all the design docs, Jira, incident bugs, everything is connected.
zh: 它覆盖了从我们的移动应用如何构建,到后端,到我们的数据湖,所有的设计文档、Jira、事故和 bug,一切都相互连接。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this enables agents to quickly find the right context within our ecosystem.
zh: 这使智能体能够在我们生态系统中快速找到正确的上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are now plugging all of our skills and use cases into the graph, whether it's our on-call RCA, whether it's our planning or data analysis or security scans.
zh: 我们现在正把所有的技能和使用场景接入这个图谱,无论是我们的值班 RCA、规划、数据分析还是安全扫描。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we see across all of this, we are improving the skills by a lot.
zh: 我们看到,在所有这些方面,我们都大幅提升了技能的效果。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm just showing a very simple example of asking a simple question of how many mobility trips in India are cache.
zh: 我在这里展示一个非常简单的例子,问一个简单的问题:印度的出行行程有多少被缓存了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This needs to understand the concepts of each of these, which tables, what kind of CTEs you need to create for the SQL.
zh: 这需要理解其中每一个概念,哪些表、SQL 需要创建什么样的 CTE。

speaker: Unknown
en: With and without graph, we see massive improvement in tokens, turns, and latency.
zh: 有图谱和没有图谱相比,我们在 token、轮次和延迟上看到了巨大的改进。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we see that across any earlier that we did within our infrastructure.
zh: 我们在我们的基础设施内所做的任何早期实验中都看到了这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the last thing is, how do we package all of this for everyone in the company to use?
zh: 最后一件事是,我们如何把所有这些打包给公司里的每个人使用?

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have our AI assistant called Cortana.
zh: 所以我们有我们的 AI 助手,叫做 Cortana。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of the things that I mentioned so far, whether it's skills, MCPs, and context graph, they're all plugged into that in every surface possible, whether it's on Slack, CLI, web.
zh: 我到目前为止提到的所有东西,无论是技能、MCP 还是上下文图谱,都接入到了每一个可能的界面中,无论是 Slack、CLI 还是网页。

speaker: Unknown
en: So anyone in the company, they can ask a simple question.
zh: 所以公司里的任何人都可以问一个简单的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can look up the context graph, invoke any skill, check any code, check any code in any code base, and give an answer across any of these surfaces.
zh: 它可以查询上下文图谱、调用任何技能、检查任何代码、检查任何代码库中的任何代码,并在上述任何界面上给出答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now we started allowing employees to even personalize that.
zh: 现在我们开始允许员工甚至对它进行个性化定制。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can hook up your custom skills, custom prompt, and hook it up into your team Slack channel so that it knows all of the things about that team and works like that teammate.
zh: 你可以接入你的自定义技能、自定义提示词,并把它接入到你的团队 Slack 频道,这样它就了解那个团队的所有事情,并像那个团队的成员一样工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is a simple example of how you can invoke the same question before in Slack and one or more people can even collaborate on the same Slack channel.
zh: 这是一个简单的例子,展示你如何在 Slack 中提出同样的问题,一个或多个人甚至可以在同一个 Slack 频道上协作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have, just in the last one month, 300 unique personas created and more than 20,000 sessions per day.
zh: 而仅在最近一个月,我们就创建了 300 个独特的个性化人设,每天有超过 20,000 个会话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll now pass on to Adam who will talk about how we take all of this and ship a feature end-to-end.
zh: 我现在把话筒交给 Adam,他将谈谈我们如何把所有这些整合起来,端到端地交付一个功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: All right.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you, Uday.
zh: 谢谢你,Uday。

speaker: Unknown
en: All right.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: As Uday said, we've got those building blocks.
zh: 正如 Uday 所说,我们已经有了那些构建模块。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to use those to power our software factory.
zh: 我们将用它们来驱动我们的软件工厂。

speaker: Unknown
